content:
ciara_csm: quick heads-up — overnight a subset of trial customers saw intermittent 401s and delayed embedding responses during onboarding. Need an interim customer-safe status + a prioritized outreach list for renewal-risk accounts.

max_ops: investigating now. Early signal: a change to our cache trimming algo reduced token residency under high ingest. That, plus an onboarding burst, caused auth state loss for some sessions. Reverted change and pushed a small patch to add headroom + a short retry backoff in the SDK.

incident_bot: Patch deployed by max_ops at 2026-05-14T04:12Z — canary checks passing.

tess_support: CS — can you surface the impacted trials and their renewal windows? We should split high-touch (exec + credits + onboarding) vs standard.

ciara_csm: pulling list. Preliminary high-touch renewals in 30 days: NovusHealth, BlueLedger, DatumAI. Mid: FormNest, RetailIQ. Low: SignalOps.

omar_sales: For NovusHealth/BlueLedger/DatumAI recommend exec note + 1-month credit OR 8 hours hands-on onboarding with an engineer + private office hours. Need finance confirmation.

rui_finance: Pre-approve one-month credits for flagged priority trials. Please make credit language explicit: "one-month credit applied to next invoice or refunded on request." Also log under CS-10234 for reconciliation.

max_ops: Customer-facing blurb for interim note: "A cache trimming parameter change interacted with an onboarding traffic spike, causing some sessions to lose token state and generate 401s; retries increased embedding latency. We've reverted the change, deployed a patch to the SDK that adds retry backoff and server-side backpressure, and increased cache headroom. Telemetry is stable." Full technical RCA and timeline will follow.

ciara_csm: Draft interim message — please review for tone/legal: 

```
Hi <Customer>,

Were writing to let you know about a transient issue on 2026-05-13 that may have affected onboarding flows. You may have seen authentication errors (401) or slower embedding responses which could have impacted evaluations or demos.

What happened (brief): a configuration change to our cache trimming logic combined with an unexpected onboarding traffic spike resulted in some tokens being evicted earlier than expected, producing authentication failures and retry-related latency for a subset of tenants.

What we did: we reverted the configuration change, pushed a patch (including a short client-side retry backoff) and increased cache headroom. Our monitoring indicates normal operation.

Next steps & remediation: we will deliver a detailed RCA within 72 hours and invite impacted customers to a prioritized onboarding session within 7 days. Affected trial customers qualifying as priority will receive a one-month service credit (applied to your next invoice or refunded on request) or equivalent engineering time.

If you experienced an issue, please reply with any example request IDs or approximate timestamps so we can correlate logs.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success
```

omar_sales: looks good. add: "we understand this may affect renewal decisions — your account exec will follow up with a tailored plan."

ciara_csm: added. plan: send interim note to impacted list in 90 minutes, prioritized exec outreach for top 3, schedule onboarding slots, and deliver full RCA in 72 hours. Any concerns? react :thumbsup: to proceed.

max_ops: :thumbsup:

tess_support: :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident severity set to P2. Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours.
